quizName: DMV Practice Test #2 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Why are signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: They serve little purpose since motorcycles are smaller than other vehicles.
They tell other drivers what you plan to do.
You should only use them if vehicles are close to you.
They are harder to use than signals on a car.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell other drivers what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: As a motorcyclist, you are more vulnerable than car drivers. Always use your turn signals when you change lanes or turn, even if you think no one is nearby.

questions.question: When should you inspect your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride to avoid problems. Small issues on a motorcycle are more dangerous than on a car.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black letters or symbols warn drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: If a friend has had too much to drink and wants to ride a motorcycle, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride if they have drunk too much alcohol. Take their keys if needed and help them find another way home.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Slow down on slippery surfaces. Use both brakes when stopping and avoid sudden movements.

questions.question: If you wait one hour for each drink before riding, what happens?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
You will be fine if you ride slowly.

questions.explanation: Your body gets rid of about one drink per hour. But alcohol can build up in your system. Even one drink per hour can still harm your riding ability.

questions.question: When does alcohol start to impair your riding?

options.text: At about half the legal limit.

questions.explanation: Even one drink can affect your riding skills. You can be impaired below the legal limit. No amount of alcohol is safe before riding.

questions.question: Where should a motorcyclist position themselves in a lane?

options.text: In the same spot in the lane all the time.
Move around the lane to keep other drivers away.
Choose a position based on road and traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Choose a position based on road and traffic.
questions.explanation: There is no best lane position for all situations. Change your position based on the road and traffic around you.

questions.question: What is the danger of riding next to a car?

options.text: You could be in the driver's blind spot.
It is only dangerous on wet roads.
It makes driving easier for the other driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could be in the driver's blind spot.
questions.explanation: Riding beside another vehicle is dangerous because the driver may not see you. The car will also block your path to escape.

questions.question: How do you make the shortest, safest stop?

options.text: Use both the front and rear brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both brakes smoothly and gradually to stop safely and quickly. Do not let either tire skid.

questions.question: Which of the following should you NOT check on your tires?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tire air pressure, general wear, and tread. You do not need to check flexibility.

questions.question: What is important to remember about blind spots on motorcycles?

options.text: Motorcycles are too small to have blind spots
Blind spots on motorcycles are too small to cause problems
Motorcycles have blind spots that require head checks
Motorcycles have only one blind spot

questions.correctAnswerText: Motorcycles have blind spots that require head checks
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like any vehicle. Always turn your head to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: What type of sign is rectangular?
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular with white backgrounds and black letters or symbols. These signs show traffic rules that you must follow.

questions.question: When stopped behind another vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Get as close as possible to the vehicle
Keep space between your motorcycle and the other vehicle
Do not use your rearview mirrors to check traffic behind you
Look for chances to squeeze through stopped traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep space between your motorcycle and the other vehicle
questions.explanation: Stay well behind the vehicle in front of you, even when stopped. This gives you room to escape if the vehicle backs up or if another vehicle comes toward you too fast.

questions.question: What type of shoes should you wear when riding?

options.text: Shoes with long laces that cannot be tucked in

questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. Heels should be short so they do not catch on anything. Laces should be tucked in so they do not catch on motorcycle parts.

questions.question: What is the only way to remove alcohol from your body?
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to sobering up.

questions.question: What must an eye or face shield do to work well?

options.text: Limit side vision so you focus on the road ahead
Not allow eyeglasses or sunglasses to be worn

questions.explanation: An effective eye or face shield must have no scratches, block penetration, allow clear views to the sides, fasten securely, let air pass through to prevent fogging, and allow room for eyeglasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: What should you check before riding?

options.text: The wear and tread of your tires

questions.correctAnswerText: The wear and tread of your tires
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, oil and fluid levels, headlight, tail light, turn signals, brake light, clutch and throttle, mirrors, brakes, and horn.

questions.question: How should jackets and pants fit for the best protection?

options.text: They should cover your arms and legs completely
They should be loose and flap in the wind
They should only partially cover your arms and legs
They should be made of wool

questions.correctAnswerText: They should cover your arms and legs completely
questions.explanation: Jackets and pants should cover your arms and legs completely. They should fit snugly but be loose enough to move freely. Leather or synthetic materials give the best protection in an accident.

questions.question: What should you do with shoelaces when riding?
questions.explanation: Always tuck in your shoelaces so they do not catch on your motorcycle.

questions.question: What is true about an approved helmet?

options.text: It lets you see clearly to the sides.
It limits your field of vision.
It has no labels or tags.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lets you see clearly to the sides.
questions.explanation: An approved helmet allows you to see clearly to the sides for safe riding. Approved helmets have labels and tags that show the manufacturer's name, instructions, and safety standards.

questions.question: How do you control the accelerator on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is on the right handgrip and you control it with your right hand.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Keep a longer distance from the vehicle ahead.
Let air out of the tires to handle the extra weight.
Do not warn the passenger about dangers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a longer distance from the vehicle ahead.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle handles differently with a passenger's weight. You need more space between you and the vehicle ahead to stop safely.

questions.question: When riding behind a car, where should you ride in the lane?

options.text: Where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
As close to the car as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror. This is usually in the center of the lane. Drivers check their rearview mirrors more often than side mirrors, so this position helps them see you.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you properly if:

options.text: You can touch your feet to the ground while sitting.
You have to stretch to reach the controls.
The handlebars are above your head.
Your feet cannot rest on the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch your feet to the ground while sitting.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you properly when your feet can touch the ground while you sit on it. You should be able to easily reach and use all the controls.
